items.question: Can I edit the text in the generated story layouts?
items.answer: Yes! Lovart's 'Text Edit' feature allows you to click on any text in the AI-generated image and change the wording, font, or correct typos instantly.

items.question: Does Lovart generate videos for Stories?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can use the 'Video Generator' tool powered by Seedance 2.0 to create 5-10 second vertical videos perfect for Instagram Stories and Reels.

items.question: Are the images copyright-free for commercial use?
items.answer: Yes, all assets generated by Lovart on paid plans come with a commercial license, allowing you to use them for your brand or client projects safely.

items.question: How do I make sure the layout fits the 9:16 aspect ratio?
items.answer: Simply select the '9:16' ratio in the settings or mention it in your prompt (e.g., 'Instagram Story format'). Lovart's Agent creates specifically for vertical mobile screens.

items.question: Can I upload my own product photos?
items.answer: Yes. You can upload your product photo and ask Lovart to 'place this product in a luxury living room setting' or 'create a story layout using this photo'.
